The web_application production image was built without a .env.local, so the frontend NEXT_PUBLIC env etc. The web container returns 500 following redirect. The documented setup uses `npm run dev` in the tooling container on port 3000. The docker build frontend (port 3003) is a separate option. Let me set up the .env.local with the token and run the dev server per guide.

Let me create the .env.local in the tooling container with the API token, npm ci in web_application, and run npm run dev.

Actually the guide says copy .env.local.example to .env.local, paste the API token, npm ci, then npm run dev. Let me do that. The API_DOMAIN is http://api which resolves within the docker network.
